```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 09_power_alternative_means
title: >
  Alternative Hypothesis z-scores
questions:
  - id: alternative_z_scores
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      If the alternative-hypothesis mean is 78 and the standard error is 10, what
      z-scores correspond to critical means of 30.40 and 69.60?
    answer: >
      Relative to the alternative distribution, the z-scores are (30.40 - 78) / 10 =
      -4.76 and (69.60 - 78) / 10 = -0.84.
    explanation: >
      These z-scores locate the null critical means inside the alternative
      distribution.
```
